evidence: The qwen3-coder solution explicitly comments `Check if the graph is bipartite`, while all solutions build an adjacency list and use a two-valued `color` array with BFS/DFS.

removal_suggestion: No task-preserving rewording can remove this affordance: assigning one of exactly two methods to endpoints of every conflicting pair is intrinsically the graph bipartiteness problem.
